tldr:
The clean marginal QTE curve in this supplied-outside-law boundary model has sharp simultaneous-band asymptotic value \(L_n(b)\to V(b)\), with finite-sample honesty retained by attaining original-data procedures. The no-information value is \((9/10)D\), where \(D=1-2/(3\sqrt{10})\), and the exact saturation budget is \(b_\star=(4/3)(D/2)/(1+D/2)\approx0.377258342560760\). Every smaller budget retains strict information. Put \(\alpha_\star=D/2\) and \(c_\star=\alpha_\star/(1+\alpha_\star)\). Across the full template of opposite extremal-shape affine paths with arbitrary Borel spatial amplitudes and nonuniform corruption allocations, the optimal common-submeasure midpoint certificate is
\[
 V(b)\ge\max_{r\in[(6b/c_\star)^{1/3},2]}
 \alpha_\star r\{e^{-\alpha_\star(r^3/6-b/c_\star)}-1/10\},
 \quad0\le b\le b_\star.
\]
Low-position indicators with exact-budget partial replacement attain this template envelope through legal smooth approximation. Its optimizing radius is interior below \(b_\dagger=3/[10(1+\alpha_\star)]\approx0.215116872923829\) and is the binding cutoff thereafter. The unchanged rational certificates give \(V(0)>0.419469622805676\) and \(V(1/24)>0.448437769242146\).
